batch: Power Options shortcut missing-target diagnostic correction and VM recheck

change.correction: When a declared shortcut target is absent, use a product-neutral diagnostic instead of the BitLocker-specific message for both BitLocker and Power Options operations.

localRegression.newCoverage: A mocked Power Options missing-target path raises the product-neutral diagnostic before WScript.Shell COM creation.
localRegression.initialDiscoveryFailure: The first Pester attempt found the seven existing tests but could not resolve InModuleScope because the module was imported in BeforeAll. Importing it in BeforeDiscovery corrected discovery; all eight cases then passed in both shells.

vmAccess.RIDE-Win11-Test: Get-VM denied before inspection: Access to a CIM resource was not available to the client.
vmAccess.RIDE-Server2025-Test: Get-VM denied before inspection: Access to a CIM resource was not available to the client.

resolved: The pending Power Options shortcut candidate no longer reports an unrelated BitLocker failure when its declared target is missing.
partial: The candidate remains a pending Windows 11 implementation and has not passed actual desktop, launch, repeat, removal or saved-state restore acceptance.
deferred: Windows 11 UI and exact lifecycle acceptance remain blocked before VM inspection by host CIM access.

estimates.adjustment: None; correcting an error diagnostic adds no legacy outcome and does not replace Windows acceptance.
